title: Matrix Transpose with Validation
learning_objectives: Reason about rows and columns by index
hints: Let `n = len(matrix[0])`; every row must satisfy `len(row) == n`.
Output row `j` is `[row[j] for row in matrix]`.
`[[row[j] for row in matrix] for j in range(n)]` builds the whole result.

failure_feedback.advice: Check every row length before transposing; zip() hides ragged rows.
The outer loop must run over columns (j), the inner over rows.
Don't create rows with `[[0]*m]*n`; each row must be a separate list.
Rows of length 0 give n = 0, so the result is [].
